newsitem.title: ALGERIA: Algerian rebels kill family of six - paper.
newsitem.headline: Algerian rebels kill family of six - paper.

text.p: Suspected Moslem rebels armed with knives killed six members of one family after breaking into their home at night, an Algerian newspaper said on Thursday.
"A terrorist gang" broke into the family home in Tajna, a small town in Chlef province 150 km (95 miles) south of Algiers, on Tuesday night, the main Arab-language paper Al Khabar said.
The newspaper, using the term which officials use to describe Moslem fundamentalists, said they killed all six members of a family they found there, including two women.

The paper also said that security forces killed between four and 14 Moslem guerrillas holed up in a tunnel under a farm near Reghaia town, 40 km (25 miles) miles east of Algiers, after a 24-hour-long siege on Tuesday.

The latest violence came as opposition parties waited for the Constitutional Council to rule on their complaints about alleged irregularities in last week's general election won by the National Democratic Rally (RND), grouping President Liamine Zeroual supporters.
The new parliament will hold its first session next Sunday.
